{{Quote|Remember I told you about Milo Pellam? Who vanished when we were captured by the Empire?|Felix Iresso talking about Milo Pellam to the Barsen'thor|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Milo Pellam''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War|renewed war]]. He served together with [[Felix Iresso]] on [[Althir III]] and they both were captured by the Sith. After the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ouzal]] tried to duplicate the informations contained in a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] into the brain of the two prisoners. The experiment of the Sith Lord was a success as Iresso had locked in a corner of his brain a library of Sith knowledge, but Pellam became mad. Some time later, he destroyed a starship belonging to a gangster, thinking it contained Doctor [[Sera Fray]]: the woman responsible for his madness. He was consequently arrested and held in isolation in Tatooine. Eventually Iresso found Milo in a prison on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and learned the truth.
